purpose: Explain anonymous behavioural drive clusters, inspect attribution confidence and outliers, and optionally create named profiles and confirm drive labels without asserting physical identity.
primaryGoal: Understand how reliably a selected vehicle's drives separate into behaviour clusters and explicitly label a drive to a named driver profile.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-positive enablement, query key includes vehicle/window/limit/offset, request receives AbortSignal. Report holds full cluster summary, first requested fingerprint page, totals, monetary currency, window, quality and evidence. Actual aggregate/pagination semantics were not exercised.
Independent vehicle-scoped items/total register; null items become an empty render collection. Request receives AbortSignal.

duplicatedPatterns.disposition: reuse investigation, not authorization to create a competing score component

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep table ownership unchanged; consider a small ownership-domain drive-reference cell only if migration actually needs both consumers changed. Preserve identifiers, date formatting and callback payload.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Full-width PageLayout; profile and assignment grids stack below md; evidence columns stack below lg; all four tables use mobileColumns allow-lists; chart is responsive with fixed 280px height.

findings.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-031 / MDC-043 preservation and mobile reachability
findings.detail: Fingerprints allow only drive/attribution/confidence below md, hiding the assign Label action and distance/duration/margin/traits. Profiles at line 702 hide Remove; cluster rows at line 629 hide seven specialist fields. GhostDrivesPanel.tsx:170 similarly omits Label, trip and deviation. DataTable.tsx:238-240 and 724-725 implement hidden md:table-cell; no mobilePresentation or separate full-detail action is supplied by these callers.
findings.fix: Adopt DataTable's existing opt-in mobile presentation/detail contract with all fields and actions, retaining loaded rows, source ordering, selection/export scope and stable table IDs. An action-column allow-list addition alone would not restore every hidden detail. Do not delete secondary information.

findings.detail: Header analysis-window select, long cluster axis labels, attribution label/badge row and toggle/save row use inline flex or chart layouts with no demonstrated 320px/long-label behavior.
findings.fix: Exercise long localized names, 200% text and narrow allocated widths before choosing wrapping or chart-label adjustments. Preserve all controls, chart data-table access and full labels.

positiveSourceEvidence: Controls use existing shared Input/Select/Toggle/Button; window select has localized aria-label at page:452.
Most meaningful action icons are aria-hidden and buttons contain localized text.
ChartContainer receives ariaLabel and all three data columns at page:561-577.
Destructive removal uses existing useConfirm and ConfirmDialog at page:107-118 and 836.
Evidence sections have aria-label and semantic h3 text wrappers.

findings.detail: The shared YAxis uses unit='%' for both share_pct and aggression_score. The aggression table represents the score as /100 at line 257, and its data-column label is a score, not a percentage. A single percentage axis conflates these source meanings.
findings.fix: Use a unit-neutral 0-100 axis with explicit localized per-series units in tooltip/accessible data, or supported distinct axes. Preserve both series, legend persistence and score meaning; do not convert aggression into a percentage claim.

states.loading: OwnershipPanel maps initial missing-data loading to SourceContent; preserveSummary retains the OwnershipBrief's own loading state. Ghost query owns its separate boundary.
states.empty: All named panels remain rendered; null arrays become empty collections. Table empties and source explanations are present. The disabled-vehicle ghost message is not trustworthy; see finding.
states.error: Source fatal errors map to shared ErrorDisplay with retry; create/delete/assignment errors use MutationError. Draft/editor remains available before a first successful register read.
states.retained: OwnershipPanel.tsx:46 maps useDataState stale status to retained. SourceContent.tsx:57-65 keeps children and supplies a polite retained notice/retry.
states.offline: Uses existing trust infrastructure; no offline browser case exercised. Source-only inspection does not prove network policy or every pending/offline transition.

findings.rule: MDC-025 / MDC-026 unknown is not success
findings.detail: When vehicleId is null, the ghost query is disabled, ghosts defaults to [], and OwnershipPanel sourceEnabled=false selects empty state. The message then says every scanned drive fits a known profile despite no selected vehicle/read. A successful response with scanned=0 also receives this all-clear assertion.
findings.fix: Distinguish selection required, not scanned/zero-sample, resolved empty with positive scanned count, loading and fatal failure. Retain explicit behavioral-not-identity language, retry, existing source boundaries and positive data.

findings.detail: Interpretation chooses strong, moderate, otherwise weak explanatory text. For a returned unknown or other verdict string it claims behaviour is too similar to separate, while VerdictBadge displays the actual unknown string. Type permits any string at ownership.ts:468.
findings.fix: Handle weak explicitly and use a localized unknown/not-computed explanation for unrecognized verdicts; retain raw verdict evidence and all strong/moderate/weak explanations.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-011 / MDC-034 / mission 5 and 7 reduced visual noise
visualIssues.detail: Independent six-color ACCENT_HEX palette fixes saturated cyan/emerald/amber/purple/rose/indigo chart fills and profile dots; accentText at lines 65-79 fixes matching body/icon hues. Aggression uses a separate literal amber RGBA at line 605.
visualIssues.fix: Resolve existing persisted accent names through the current canonical chart/theme palette and restrained semantic tokens. Keep profile accent choice, identity distinguishability and legend/table text; do not reset stored accents or explicit user chart choices. Prefer neutral identity text and smaller color cues over coloring every label.

visualIssues.detail: Assignment form uses fixed white border/background opacity; EvidencePanel.tsx:129 repeats fixed white decorative evidence tiles. These do not follow theme-neutral surface/border tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing subdued surface and border tokens without an extra card engine or stronger decoration. Retain the form grouping and each evidence source, summary, sample count and date.

visualIssues.detail: Aggression score caption bypasses typography roles with text-xs; its muted color is token-based already. Ghost/attribution score colors and evidence section icons additionally use fixed color shades.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Caption/Text role for /100 metadata and muted semantic tones appropriate to actual meaning. Preserve tabular numbers and visible numeric/word explanations, not color-only classifications.

architectureIssues.detail: Time-scoped report and ghost queries use local windowDays and page contextActions window select (lines 450-460), not useRangeState. Route is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS in workspaceScope.ts:23-77, so the shell range owner is disabled here. Hooks accept window_days only, not both URL/shared bounds.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must first establish actual report/ghost endpoint support for explicit start/end bounds and full-range filtering, then register the exact route and consume the shared range owner. Preserve current 30/60/90/180/365-day capabilities and selected vehicle. Do not merely remove the existing functioning window control or pretend backend custom/DST range support exists.

architectureIssues.detail: Columns declare sortable:true at lines 199,206,261,329,336, but DataTable callers provide no onSort/sortKey/sortDir or sorted rows. Ghost table similarly declares sortable flags. DataTable.tsx:1557 only mounts interactive sort headers with onSort. This is inert declarative metadata, not verified sorting.
architectureIssues.fix: Wire existing caller-owned typed sorting with source field accessors where sorting is intended. Keep original default ordering, stable IDs, monetary/physical raw values, null ordering and export scope. Do not replace DataTable or claim sorting already works.

architectureIssues.detail: VerdictBadge falls back to raw lowercased English strings; its tone map lacks strong/moderate/weak. Page:797 does not supply label. EvidencePanel.tsx:72 renders quality.status verbatim, and profile accent option labels are raw accent codes at page:676.
architectureIssues.fix: Supply localized visible labels while preserving raw source and stored accent identifiers. Ownership-domain owner should explicitly map separation verdict semantics using existing Badge variants, not create a global competing status registry. Catalog changes belong to their assigned owner.

architectureIssues.detail: Report requests limit=100 offset=0. Fingerprints table receives those loaded rows only; page:783 reports shown/total without pagination or a full-result fetch. Existing shared CSV/JSON controls therefore export loaded matching rows, not every report.total drive.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the current loaded-scope exports accurately labeled. If the desired modernization promises all drives, integration must wire the existing endpoint limit/offset and DataTable pagination/exportAll contract, without changing whole-range cluster summaries or silently widening export scope.
